chain.deposit.v1.CreateDepositAddressReq.description:
CreateDepositAddressRequest creates or returns the deposit address for one
 selected account target and chain.

chainId.description: PolyChain-registered source chain id to assign the deposit address for.
chainId.title: chain_id

subaccountId.description:
Optional subaccount public id. When omitted, the authenticated caller's
 root account is used as the target account.
subaccountId.title: subaccount_id

chain.deposit.v1.CreateDepositAddressReq.title: CreateDepositAddressRequest

chain.deposit.v1.CreateDepositAddressRes.description:
CreateDepositAddressResponse returns the assigned deposit address for the
 requested target and chain.

depositAddress.description: Assigned deposit address for the requested target and chain.
depositAddress.title: deposit_address

chain.deposit.v1.CreateDepositAddressRes.title: CreateDepositAddressResponse

chain.deposit.v1.ListDepositAddressesRes.description:
ListDepositAddressesResponse returns the known deposit addresses for the
 selected target, ordered by ascending chain id.

depositAddresses.description: Known deposit addresses for the selected target.
depositAddresses.title: deposit_addresses
